villains.name: The Bubbler
goals: To get rid of all adults
villains.quote: Let's get this party started!
villains.second_quote: No more adults means total freedom! This is SOOO sweet! Off the hook!

villains.name: Mr. Pigeon
goals: To save the pigeons of Paris
To turn Paris into a paradise for pigeons by turning all humans into pigeons
villains.quote: Perfect timing, hootie ho! We're ready to greet them, aren't we? They're going to fall right into my trap. It won't be long before you get your Miraculous, friend.
villains.second_quote: Oh, dreary day, poor Parisians. Sorry to ruffle your feathers, but Paris now belongs to the pigeons! Flap flap!
power_and_ability: Pigeon control and turning people into evil pigeons

villains.name: Stormy Weather
goals: To get revenge on everybody who turned her down
villains.quote: Hahahaha! I am Stormy Weather. The only weather girl who always gets the forecast right! And unfortunately for you, there's a freak icy front moving in right now!
villains.second_quote: In Stormy Weather's world, it's winter wonderland FOREVER!

villains.name: Timebreaker
goals: To go back in time to save a family heirloom from being broken
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again
villains.quote: One and a half minutes. You won't be able to stop me where I'm going, Ladybug
villains.second_quote: The name's Timebreaker now. And I'm gonna go back in time and save my watch, using all you punks to do it!

villains.name: Copycat
goals: To replace Cat Noir and win Ladybug's heart
villains.quote: Don't mind me. Just stealing this painting. Go about your business.
villains.second_quote: Too late, Cat. Ladybug's on her way, which was my plan all along.

villains.name: The Pharaoh
goals: To perform an ancient ritual to revive Queen Nefertiti
villains.second_quote: Ladybug, my sworn enemy! My nemesis may have kept me from carrying out my ritual 5,000 years ago, but she will not stop Nefertiti from coming back to me this time!

villains.name: Lady Wifi
goals: To reveal the secret identity of Ladybug
To assist Puppeteer in getting Ladybug's Miraculous
To get revenge on Adrien, later Felix for his video
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again
villains.quote: I am Lady Wifi, revealer of the truth!

villains.name: The Evillustrator
goals: To get revenge on Chloe
villains.quote: So, I just came by to ask you, it, uh, well, it's my birthday today, and, uh, would you wanna come to my party?
villains.second_quote: Chloé, where are you? Are you hiding? That is so cute. You're playing hide-and-seek. In the closet?!

villains.name: Rogercop
goals: To punish the mayor for firing him
villains.quote: If no one speaks up, I'll put you all under arrest! Where is your father?
villains.second_quote: Justice doesn't need an invitation. Mayor, you're under arrest for abuse of power.

villains.name: Dark Cupid
goals: To spread hate in all of Paris
villains.quote: I can help you crush Ladybug, but you must give me her Miraculous in return.
villains.second_quote: I'm not Kim, I'm Dark Cupid! I'll never stop! If I can't have love, then no one can!

villains.name: Horrificator
goals: To make people feel her fear
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again

villains.name: Darkblade
goals: To take back Paris for the original Darkblade
villains.quote: Henceforth, my flag shalt fly over thy kingdom! Bourgeois, pathetic knave, come hither and do battle!
villains.second_quote: Ha ha ha ha ha! Bow down to Darkblade, or feel the wrath of mine sword!

villains.name: The Mime
goals: To get revenge on Chris for stealing his part in a performance

villains.name: Princess Fragrance
goals: To be with Prince Ali
To get revenge on Adrien, later Felix for his video
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again
villains.quote: My prince, my prince, smell the fragrance of my eternal love!
villains.second_quote: I'm Princess Fragrance and I've come just for you! In just a spritz, you'll be mine, Prince Ali!

villains.name: Stoneheart
goals: To get revenge on the people who wronged him
To be with Mylene
villains.second_quote: Ugh! You wanted the cavalry? Well, here it is! Seize him!
power_and_ability: Control over an army of rock-golems (after the akuma isn't purified)

villains.name: Animan
goals: To teach Kim a lesson
villains.second_quote: You lost, kiddo. What do you think of panthers now?

villains.name: Simon Says
goals: To prove he can hypnotize Gabriel Agreste
villains.quote: Welcome to another exciting hour of 'The Challenge'! Good evening again from Simon Says. Viewers, I've kept my promise. Here's Gabriel!
villains.second_quote: Simon says... search all over Paris, my army, and find Gabriel Agreste!

villains.name: Pixelator
goals: To capture Jagged Stone in one of his pictures
villains.quote: Look into the lens.

villains.name: Guitar Villain
goals: To make everyone dance and get revenge on XY for insulting him
villains.quote: Rockin' Riff, baby!
villains.second_quote: Soon, there'll be nothing but Guitar Villain fans, the one and only rocker on Earth.

villains.name: Kung Food
goals: To get revenge on Chloé for sabotaging his soup and making him lose the World's Greatest Chef contest
villains.quote: You want to taste Kung Food's soup. Everybody become my servants, and Kung Food become 'World's Greatest Chef'! Hahahaha!
villains.second_quote: Kung Food will make new soup called Brat Soup!
power_and_ability: Mind control (over anyone who ate his sabotaged soup)

villains.name: Gamer
goals: To be the greatest gamer in Paris
villains.quote: Welcome to Miraculous All-Star Brawl! If you win, I'll set you free. You, and all of them. But if you lose...
villains.second_quote: Game over, Marinette!

villains.name: Reflekta
goals: To be noticed
To wants to learn the secrets that Marinette is keeping from them so that they can be friends again
To wants to drown herself in her own guilt and for her classmates to go back to treating Rose like a normal person
villains.quote: Nobody's ever noticed me! But those days are over! But from now on, everybody will notice me because everybody will look like me! Time to get a new look!
villains.second_quote: Don't worry, I'll take care of it! Hahahaha! Where is Chloé Bourgeois!?

villains.name: The Puppeteer
goals: To get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Dolls
villains.quote: I want... those... dolls!
villains.second_quote: Okay, Lady Wifi. Come to life!

villains.name: Vanisher
goals: To get revenge on Chloé for pretending she didn't exist
villains.quote: Just because you can see me, doesn't mean you'll defeat me Ladybug!
villains.second_quote: You've got no friends left, Chloé. And you'll never have any, EVER again. I'll make sure of that.

villains.name: Antibug
goals: To get revenge on Ladybug for betraying her fan
villains.quote: Wrong, super wrong. I am Antibug!
villains.second_quote: Ha ha ha ha! If it weren't for me, you wouldn't have defeated Vanisher. And now, I'm going to defeat you!

villains.name: Volpina
goals: To get revenge on Ladybug for exposing her as a liar
villains.quote: I am Volpina, the only superhero Paris needs.
villains.second_quote: Everyone thinks I'm a superhero, including Cat Noir. So you won't be able to call me a liar anymore cause everyone will think you're the liar.

villains.name: Santa Claws
goals: To punish everyone for not respecting the Christmas spirit
villains.quote: You think you can get away with making fun of me? You think you can get away with accusing me? I am Santa Claws! I'm a rebel with a cause! I'll punish and give you a fright! Have a horrible Christmas night.
villains.second_quote: There are no more presents, no more spirit of Christmas! You should've been good.

villains.name: The Collector
goals: To replace his lost inspirational book with a new one, as well as lead Ladybug and Cat Noir astray from his identity as Hawk Moth
villains.quote: Since the book that used to fill my life is gone, I'm going to use your life to fill up this new one!
villains.second_quote: You will call me... the Collector.

villains.name: Prime Queen
goals: To get Ladybug and Cat Noir to admit they're in love so she can get the highest ratings
villains.quote: Tonight, Ladybug and Cat Noir disappointed all their loyal fans by refusing to admit their love for one another. I've prepared some trials just to see how far they're prepared to keep the truth hidden from us.
villains.second_quote: Our two heroic lovebirds are saving their fan's life by admitting their true feelings. Our viewers are going crazy! But, our TV ratings haven't maxed out yet. You must do better!

villains.name: Despair Bear
goals: To get Chloé to pay for being mean
villains.quote: You've been very naughty, Chloékins. And Despair Bear is not proud of you. The time has come to make you pay!
villains.second_quote: I hope you're having fun, Chloékins!

villains.name: Riposte
goals: To get revenge on Adrien for her losing to him in a fencing match
villains.quote: Allow me to explain the rules to you... you're not allowed to call it quits at any time! Adrien is mine! I will defeat you. Both of you! I am the best fencer!
villains.second_quote: Give me a moment, Adrien. I must finish her off, first! But don't worry- I haven't forgotten about you! I won't be long.

villains.name: Befana
goals: To punish her granddaughter, Marinette for not wanting to spend time with her
villains.quote: La Befana comes at night, on her shaky broom in flight. She gives candy to those who are dandy.
villains.second_quote: I'm not your grandma anymore. From now on, I am only Befana! And I'm going to punish you for all those lies!

villains.name: Robostus
goals: To steal the Miraculous and become human
To destroy all humans
villains.quote: From now on, I am Robostus. And we shall be together one hundred percent of the time. Forever!
villains.second_quote: I'm going to take over their Miraculous so we'll never be separated again! Then I'll be able to make my wish come true!

villains.name: Dark Owl
goals: To become a superhero
To get the Miraculous
villains.quote: And if anyone should be 'tempt to come and save the animals, beware! It is all rig! Liquid nitrogen will automatically douse the feet of the Eiffel Tower, freezing them to -700 degree, and making them more fragile than glass! They will collapse! And the bus will flatten our cute kitten friend!
villains.second_quote: Ladybug, Cat Noir the only way you can save these sweet animals is to come and hand your Miraculouses over to me! And you only have 10 minutes! Follow the Owl-Signal!

villains.name: Gigantitan
goals: To eat a lollipop
villains.quote: Lollipop!
villains.second_quote: Kitty!

villains.name: Glaciator
goals: To get Marinette to find true love from his ice cream
villains.second_quote: I'm Glaciator, the mean ice-cream man. Escape my fury if you can! I melt your hearts, but I was wrong, now I'll freeze your bodies so long!

villains.name: Sapotis
goals: To cause mischief
villains.quote: Rock n' roll!
villains.second_quote: Miraculous!

villains.name: Gorizilla
goals: To keep a close watch on Adrien

villains.name: Captain Hardrock
goals: To steal Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous
villains.quote: Your mom has weighed anchor, me lad, I'm Captain Hardrock and today Paris's timbers are about to be shivered by my cannons. Westward ho, Liberty next stop, Jagged Stone at the Eiffel Tower. Soon, there will only be one concert in Paris only one Music Festival. We will destroy all the others. Now, get to your instruments and rock those decibels!
villains.second_quote: Nothing and no one will stop Captain Hardrock from playing her music! Fire!

villains.name: Frightningale
goals: To turn Paris into one big music video
villains.quote: I'm Frightningale from here on out, Forever and ever, there's no doubt! And if you stand in my way, There'll be a price to pay!
villains.second_quote: Sing, dance or rhyme, Or you'll be frozen in no time!

villains.name: Syren
goals: To create an undersea kingdom for herself and Kim
villains.quote: Yes, Kim! You'll be my Prince, and we'll rule this underwater city together, forever!
villains.second_quote: I'm your Syren now. And you can be my merman. It only needs a kiss, and you'll become just like me!

villains.name: Zombizou
goals: To have people to 'feel the love'.
villains.quote: I took care of your father, Chloé. Show yourself! Then, Ladybug and Cat Noir? I'm coming for you. Mwah! Unless, of course, my sweethearts get hold of you first; because very soon, the whole city will be hot on your heels!
villains.second_quote: I have got some great news for you, students! From now on, everyone's going to hug and kiss and feel the love! Even you, Chloé.

villains.name: Frozer
goals: To turn Paris into his own personal ice rink
villains.second_quote: Ladybug and Cat Noir. Your frozen statues will sparkle like trophies upon my kingdom of ice!

villains.name: Style Queen
goals: To get revenge on Gabriel Agreste
To get revenge on everyone who made a fun of her, especially on Senti Alec for embarrassing her on live television
villains.quote: Well then. If fashion-disaster daddy isn't here, I'll just have to settle for Agreste Junior! You're fired!
villains.second_quote: Claudine— uh, Chloé. I'm 'not' mom, I am Style Queen. Do you want to be fired, too?

villains.name: Troublemaker
goals: To cause problems for everyone else
villains.second_quote: There's no more Penny to deal with all your problems, Jagged! From now on, there's only Troublemaker! And I'll make your life nothing but problems!

villains.name: Reverser
goals: To get revenge on Nathaniel for destroying his notebook and Marinette for convincing him to step out of his comfort zone, only to be disappointed
villains.quote: Reversion!
villains.second_quote: I'm not Marc anymore. I am Reverser! And you, Marinette, the one who caused all this! You think you're the super helpful girl who's loved by everyone? Well, from now on, everyone will hate you! Reversion!

villains.name: Anansi
goals: To show how dangerous the world is to Alya
villains.second_quote: Now that you can't cheat anymore, cappie, show us just how you plan to protect your friends. Come and get her if you're not a fly-weight!

villains.name: Malediktator
goals: To prove to his daughter that he isn't powerless
To want to the citizens of Paris to go along with his construction project without protest
villains.quote: By the power invested in me, I declare you all... MY SLAVES!!!

villains.name: Sandboy
goals: To bring nightmares to life
villains.quote: The Sandboy just checked in. Now nightmares can begin.
power_and_ability: Power nullification (as long as it's a fear)

villains.name: Catalyst
goals: To assist Hawk Moth in taking Ladybug and Cat Noir's miraculous
villains.quote: Nothing's more delightful than leading them to believe that they actually have a chance of winning when their future has already been decided!
villains.second_quote: Hawk Moth, I give you the power to release as many akumas as you desire. From now on, you are the all-mighty Scarlet Moth.

villains.name: Animaestro
goals: To people to recognize him as a big shot
villains.second_quote: So you really think a director does nothing? Let me show you exactly what I'm capable of.
power_and_ability: Various superpowers (depending on the form he takes)

villains.name: Bakerix
goals: To punish people for not doing things the old-fashioned way
villains.quote: That's not how it's done!

villains.name: Backwarder
goals: To steal time by setting people in time backwards
villains.quote: There you are again, you ghastly bug! Once I've touched you, all I have to do is wait for you to transform back!
villains.second_quote: No more time to waste!

villains.name: Weredad
goals: To protect his daughter from heartbreak
villains.quote: How dare you come back after what you've done?
villains.second_quote: I forbid you to rescue her! You don't deserve to save her. From now on, no one else but I will protect her!

villains.name: Silencer
goals: Get Bob Roth to tell the truth on television
villains.quote: You’re the most extraordinary girl, Marinette. Clear as a musical note and as sincere as a melody. You’re the music that’s been playing inside my head since the day we first met. I won’t let anything happen to you.
villains.second_quote: Don't worry, Marinette. I would never hurt you. I will use the power Hawk Moth has given me to restore justice. I will force Bob Roth to admit what he has done to you and Kitty Section.

villains.name: Party Crasher
goals: To get revenge on Adrien for lying to him about not being allowed to have friends over and for not being invited to Adrien's party
villains.quote: Idiot! You can't get me! I can read your every dance step! Disco!
villains.second_quote: So, Adrien? Too busy for your number one fan? Well I'll make sure you never forget to invite me to one of your parties again. Adrien! Where are you, Adrien!?
power_and_ability: Control over his disco ball gauntlets

villains.name: Christmaster
goals: To get his Christmas present early
villains.quote: You were tricked! That's Cat Noir dressed up as Santa Claus, not the other way around! You're such babies!
villains.second_quote: I have my secret weapons to fight you with. Yourselves! Have fun dumb-dumbs!

villains.name: Kwamibuster
goals: To get the kwamis
villains.second_quote: I'm going to capture your kwamis and prove to everyone that these magic creatures really do exist! True or false?

villains.name: Feast
goals: To sate its unyielding hunger by feasting on all of the Miraculouses

villains.name: Ikari Gozen
goals: To punish Kagami after she disobeys her by participating in the Friendship Day games
villains.quote: You'll never catch me! I'm Ikari Gozen. As elusive as the wind, as powerful as the flood, as swift as lightning!
villains.second_quote: Kagami! You disobeyed me! You will never go out again!

villains.name: Desperada
goals: To punish Jagged Stone for firing her and having the gall to try replacing her
villains.quote: In that case, you'll be my first choice too! I never miss a musical note. Vivica ALWAYS hits her targets!
villains.second_quote: Jagged Stone! So you fire me, and now you want to replace me with what? A school-kid?

villains.name: Startrain
goals: To become an astronaut and explore the galaxy with everyone on board the train
villains.quote: Why? Now I have a hundred percent chance of traveling the universe! And I get to take you with me, too! Isn't this fantastic?
villains.second_quote: Ladies and gentlemen, I am Startrain! You all get to live my dream with me! Shoot off the rails, and fly off in a rocket to explore not just the moon, but the entire universe!

villains.name: Cat Blanc
goals: To take Ladybug's miraculous
villains.quote: I'm not Cat Noir anymore. I'm Cat Blanc
villains.second_quote: An eraser? I'd like to erase the past too, but there's only one way to do that. You know that by merging our Miraculous together, we'd be granted one wish, right? Any wish we wanted. Well, my wish would be to fix everything, so we could be in love again. And have a hamster, too. You've always dreamed of having one. We'll call it...

villains.name: Truth
goals: To learn the secret that Marinette is keeping from him
villains.second_quote: Perfect that should hold all her secrets. Good job Light Eye, stay where you are, I'll be there soon.

villains.name: Lies
goals: To get rid the world from lies
villains.second_quote: And you mother, have you lied as well?

villains.name: Furious Fu
goals: To take back the walking stick that Su-Han rudely took from him and make Su-Han apologize to his wife for causing her distress
villains.quote: Oh so this is your silly little plan. I know what you gonna do.
villains.second_quote: Thunder!

villains.name: Sole Crusher
goals: To step over Chloé and show her she can be at her level and even better
villains.quote: The student has become the master, Chloé, and now, I'm going to crush you!
power_and_ability: Absorbing people by stomp or kick on them

villains.name: Queen Banana
goals: To get revenge on Miss Bustier's class for removing her from the movie Terrificator and on Zoé for taking her role as the main character
villains.quote: You'll have to come out sometime, Ladybug, especially if you don't wanna see my monkey make a banana smoothie out of your kitty!
power_and_ability: Wields a banana gun that turns people into bananas

villains.name: Queen Wasp
goals: To be exceptional
To get Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculous
villains.quote: So, who's exceptional now, then? Them… or me?
villains.second_quote: Your reign is over, Ladybug and Cat Noir! I don't even care if you don't give me your Miraculous; my wasps will paralyze you and I'll simply take them myself.

villains.name: Rena Rage
goals: To beat Carapace to prove that he is 'a flyweight'
villains.second_quote: I am now, Rena Rage!

villains.name: Shell Shock
goals: To be with Rena Rouge to love him again
villains.second_quote: There is no more Carapace. There is only Shell Shock!

villains.name: Chameleon
goals: To have another chance of defeating Ladybug
villains.quote: You're right, I'm Chameleon. You're getting better at this, Ladybug. Which is a good thing. It'll make this fight all the more interesting.
villains.second_quote: That's your plan to defeat me, Ladybug? Make me dress like you? On second thought, such horrible fashion might actually do me in.

villains.name: Oni-Chan
goals: To keep Lila away from Adrien
villains.quote: I will protect you from anyone who tries to harm you. I'll protect you from Lila.
villains.second_quote: Well this time you're gonna have to give in. Otherwise you'll really get it, whether you want it or not.

villains.name: Miraculer
goals: To get Chloe to play with her again
villains.quote: I'm Miraculer now! I've stolen Cat Noir and Ladybug's superpowers! Do you want Ladybug's? Then you can be Ladybug, and I'll be Cat Noir! For real! Just like we've always dreamed of!
villains.second_quote: I was about to, but... Ridiculous! Utterly ridiculous!

villains.name: Timetagger
goals: To steal Ladybug and Cat Noir's Miraculouses and return the Miraculouses to the Future Hawk Moth before they can become adults
villains.quote: If you don't give me your Miraculous, I'll send everyone into the past.
villains.second_quote: Yo-yo! I'm Timetagger from the future, man! I criss-cross time with a spraypaint can. Looks like your time's up at last, 'cause I'm gonna send you way back to the past!

villains.name: Heart Hunter
goals: To devour all the love in Paris so that no one could enjoy it when they couldn't
villains.quote: And for dessert, the cat! I'm sure he's very tasty.
villains.second_quote: Haha! I am the most powerful of all the super villains.

villains.name: Oblivio
goals: To make people forget their embarrassing moment of being caught playing Super Penguino by their classmates
villains.quote: You remember your BFF Oblivio, don't you? Don't tell us you've forgotten us. Ha ha ha ha!
villains.second_quote: Ladybug, Cat Noir, we know you're in here. You won't get away this time.

villains.name: Miracle Queen
goals: To get revenge against Ladybug after she refuses to lend her the Bee Miraculous, despite her genuine desire to help
villains.quote: You were once Ladybug and Cat Noir's minions, but from now on, you will be Miracle Queen's royal guard!
villains.second_quote: People of Paris, listen to Miracle Queen's first order! From now on, no one will have to keep his identity a secret! All the Miraculous wearers, come to me!

villains.name: Rocketeer
goals: To get revenge against Cat Noir for flirting with his girlfriend, Alya
